surprise.text: Nothing in this chapter particularly surprised me; the need for reserve-powered refrigeration followed from the prior cold-pack explanation and the new goal.

continue.text: Yes, I would continue to see how the storm ends and whether the discovery reaches Earth, though this chapter's mechanical choices alone would not draw me onward.
